title: Concept: Overly broad file permissions (go) — review required
description: In go, os.OpenFile(p, f, 0o777) sets permission bits that include world access. Broad modes on code, keys, or data turn any local account into a writer or reader. The remedy is least-privilege modes via 0o644/0o755 least privilege.
applicability: go code and scripts setting file modes; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Local tampering or disclosure; MEDIUM severity, HIGH for executables, keys, and configuration.
